test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 03 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, W, X, and Y are sitting in a straight line facing north.

Only three people sit to the left of D. Only A sits to the right of C. Only three people sit between C and B. X sits somewhere to the left of Y but somewhere to the right of W.

How many people sit between W and Y?
solution:
**Given:**

Seven people, A, B, C, D, W, X, and Y, are sitting in a straight line, facing north.

1) Only three people sit to the left of D. (D is at the 4th position from the left)

2) Only A sits to the right of C.

3) Only three people sit between C and B. (B is at the 2nd position)

4) X sits somewhere to the left of Y but somewhere to the right of W. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5c758983bd34b4434bfc393b362c844f8e99baa3b077e670d93be70f3b4a793.png] 

Thus, three people (B, X, and D) sit between W and Y.

Hence, the correct answer is **Option 1.**
